title: Kiosk Dashboard Date and Selection Contrast
lede: The dashboard now uses the shortest useful date language and a neutral selected state, so time urgency and interaction state do not compete for the same red accent.

stats.n: Today and Tomorrow replace sentence-style due labels
Weekday, month, and day stay visible before the due time
White contrast carries selection; red stays semantic

sections.heading: Side by side
sections.note: Same iPad Air 11-inch simulator, same kiosk fixture, same default Checkouts state. The clock/freshness stamp naturally advanced between captures; the changed labels and tile state are the intended differences.

pairs.title: Due copy and selected tile
pairs.sub: Compare the first due pill and the selected Checkouts tile.
pairs.beforeCap: The due label said `Due today`, future dates dropped the month/day, and selection turned the whole tile red.
pairs.afterCap: The label says `Today`; future rows retain `Mon, Aug 31`; the selected tile uses a bright neutral outline/underline, leaving red available for overdue meaning.

changes.h: Short dates carry the useful calendar context
changes.was: Today and tomorrow were written as `Due today` / `Due tomorrow`, while later dates used only a weekday in the compact dashboard pill.
changes.now: The dashboard says `Today` or `Tomorrow`, and all other dates retain a short `Mon, Aug 15`-style date before the time. Near-deadline and overdue wording is unchanged.

changes.h: Selection no longer borrows urgency red
changes.was: Selected stat tiles used brand red for the number, icon, border, and underline, competing with Return actions and overdue state.
changes.now: Selection is a neutral lifted surface with a white outline, underline, and icon. Overdue counts remain red when their meaning is actually urgent.

verification: 19 focused Vitest source-contract tests pass across the idle dashboard, sleep-mode removal, and iOS quality contracts.
WisconsinKiosk Xcode build and run succeeds on the iPad Air 11-inch (M4) simulator, iOS 26.5.
Runtime snapshots confirm `Today · 12:00 PM`, `Mon, Aug 31 · 12:00 PM`, and neutral selection in both Checkouts and Items Out states.
notes: The fixture currently shows the today and future-date branches. The short `Due in …` and `Overdue · …` branches remain source-tested and build-verified, but still deserve a live fixture/device replay during kiosk QA.
No API, schema, custody, or detail-surface behavior changed.
